title: Lookup pick fills the declared fields in the record form and the line-item grid (lookupAutofill, ui half of #27945)
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwb6hBqszPTYJobitm

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. This is the ui half that #27945 names; #27945 came from #27434 row 3. The spec half is PR #28244, which declares `FieldSchema.lookupAutofill`. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and routes the card to the `ui/` lane.

Reach: any record form with a lookup whose target carries values to copy, such as a quote line's Sales Price from the product (HotCRM, #27434 row 3). Today a pick fills nothing until a server hook runs on save. Once #28244 merges, an author can declare `lookupAutofill: [{ target, source, overwrite? }]` on a single-value `lookup` or `master_detail` field, but no renderer performs the fill yet.

## Wanted (the rule as #28244 declares it, read from its describe)

- On a pick in the record form (`LookupField` or the form renderer) and in the line-item grid (`GridField` / `hydrateColumns`), write each declared `target` from the picked record's `source`.
- Overwrite rule: fill only a target that is empty or that an earlier pick filled. `overwrite: true` replaces the value.
- The grid column key `autofill` (same-named copy, on by default) is unchanged. A declared pair takes its target out of the same-named copy.
- Tests:
  - a pick fills an empty target;
  - an author's own value is kept;
  - `overwrite: true` replaces it;
  - the grid with a declared pair;
  - control: a lookup without the key fills nothing new.

This lands after PR #28244 merges. The skills and docs text is #28246's job, and it lands with this card.

Links: #27945, PR #28244, #27434 (row 3).

Blocked-by: #28244
